scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes_title: v19: bigger, friendlier eyes closer to the beak (your pick, C)
notes: v19 = v18 + option C from the four eye options. The eyes sit closer to the beak (48° round from the front instead of 58°), are about 20% bigger and a touch lower to clear the cap, and have bigger pupils looking forward and a little up, with a bigger white shine. Also fixed: the red and white parts overlapped slightly inside the head, under the B's on the cap. It was invisible but could confuse the slicer. Everything else is as in v18.
